candidates.title: ChatGPT mobile app gets voice-based agentic features
candidates.summary: Pro and Plus users will be able to use the Work tab on their phones to complete agentic tasks.
candidates.angle: ChatGPT users can now execute hands-free, multi-step agentic tasks directly from their phone using voice.

candidates.title: Bernie Sanders proposes banning ‘superintelligence’ and putting violators in prison
candidates.summary: Sen. Bernie Sanders (I-VT) and Rep. Greg Casar (D-TX) have introduced new legislation that would ban anyone from developing artificial superintelligence - a technology the bill describes as capable of the "destruction or disempowerment of humanity," including by overthrowing the government. Under the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act, AI leaders would face up to 20 years […]
candidates.angle: Shocking new US legislation proposes prison time for developers attempting to build artificial superintelligence.

candidates.title: YouTube will let you build your own algorithm with AI
candidates.summary: YouTube’s new custom feeds let users describe the videos they want to see in their own words, then use Gemini to build a personalized feed around the request.
candidates.angle: YouTube is letting users take control of their algorithm by prompting Gemini to build custom video feeds.
